sentences.text_target: Tom arrives at his office in the morning.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm əˈraɪvz ət hɪz ˈɒfɪs ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Tom arrive à son bureau le matin.

sentences.text_target: He sits down at his wooden desk.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː sɪts daʊn ət hɪz ˈwʊdn dɛsk/
sentences.text_native: Il s'assoit à son bureau en bois.

sentences.text_target: He opens his laptop and enters his password.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈəʊpənz hɪz ˈlæptɒp ənd ˈɛntərz hɪz ˈpɑːswɜːd/
sentences.text_native: Il ouvre son ordinateur portable et entre son mot de passe.

sentences.text_target: The desktop appears on the bright screen.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɛsktɒp əˈpɪəz ɒn ðə braɪt skriːn/
sentences.text_native: Le bureau apparaît sur l'écran lumineux.

sentences.text_target: He checks his new email inbox.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː tʃɛks hɪz njuː ˈiːmeɪl ˈɪnbɒks/
sentences.text_native: Il vérifie sa nouvelle boîte de réception d'e-mails.

sentences.text_target: A colleague sends an important message.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈkɒliːɡ sɛndz ən ɪmˈpɔːtənt ˈmɛsɪdʒ/
sentences.text_native: Un collègue envoie un message important.

sentences.text_target: There is a digital attachment in the message.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə ˈdɪdʒɪtəl əˈtætʃmənt ɪn ðə ˈmɛsɪdʒ/
sentences.text_native: Il y a une pièce jointe dans le message.

sentences.text_target: Tom opens a large spreadsheet file.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ˈəʊpənz ə lɑːrdʒ ˈspriːdʃiːt faɪl/
sentences.text_native: Tom ouvre un grand fichier de tableur.

sentences.text_target: The table has many rows and columns.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈteɪbl hæz ˈmɛni rəʊz ənd ˈkɒləmz/
sentences.text_native: Le tableau comporte de nombreuses lignes et colonnes.

sentences.text_target: He types numbers into every single cell.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː taɪps ˈnʌmbərz ˈɪntuː ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡl sɛl/
sentences.text_native: Il tape des chiffres dans chaque cellule.

sentences.text_target: Suddenly, a strange error appears.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsʌdənli, ə streɪndʒ ˈɛrər əˈpɪəz/
sentences.text_native: Soudain, une étrange erreur apparaît.

sentences.text_target: The software system stops working properly.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɒftwɛər ˈsɪstəm stɒps ˈwɜːkɪŋ ˈprɒpəli/
sentences.text_native: Le système logiciel cesse de fonctionner correctement.

sentences.text_target: Tom clicks on the undo button quickly.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm klɪks ɒn ði ʌnˈduː ˈbʌtn ˈkwɪkli/
sentences.text_native: Tom clique rapidement sur le bouton annuler.

sentences.text_target: He decides to delete the bad data.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː dɪˈsaɪdz tuː dɪˈliːt ðə bæd ˈdeɪtə/
sentences.text_native: Il décide de supprimer les données erronées.

sentences.text_target: Then he copies information from a secure folder.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn hiː ˈkɒpiz ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃən frəm ə sɪˈkjʊə ˈfəʊldər/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il copie des informations depuis un dossier sécurisé.

sentences.text_target: He pastes the correct numbers in the table.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː peɪsts ðə kəˈrɛkt ˈnʌmbərz ɪn ðə ˈteɪbl/
sentences.text_native: Il colle les bons chiffres dans le tableau.

sentences.text_target: He saves the document to keep it safe.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː seɪvz ðə ˈdɒkjʊmənt tuː kiːp ɪt seɪf/
sentences.text_native: Il enregistre le document pour le mettre en sûreté.

sentences.text_target: He makes a backup copy on the network.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː meɪks ə ˈbækʌp ˈkɒpi ɒn ðə ˈnɛtwɜːk/
sentences.text_native: Il fait une copie de sauvegarde sur le réseau.

sentences.text_target: The boss walks by his desk and smiles.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə bɒs wɔːks baɪ hɪz dɛsk ənd smaɪlz/
sentences.text_native: Le patron passe près de son bureau et sourit.

sentences.text_target: The manager wants a physical paper report.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈmænɪdʒər wɒnts ə ˈfɪzɪkəl ˈpeɪpər rɪˈpɔːt/
sentences.text_native: Le manager souhaite un rapport imprimé sur papier.

sentences.text_target: Tom connects his laptop to the printer.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm kəˈnɛkts hɪz ˈlæptɒp tuː ðə ˈprɪntə/
sentences.text_native: Tom connecte son ordinateur portable à l'imprimante.

sentences.text_target: He clicks on the print icon.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː klɪks ɒn ðə prɪnt ˈaɪkɒn/
sentences.text_native: Il clique sur l'icône d'impression.

sentences.text_target: The machine starts to make noise.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃiːn stɑːts tuː meɪk nɔɪz/
sentences.text_native: La machine commence à faire du bruit.

sentences.text_target: White paper comes out very fast.
sentences.phonetic: /waɪt ˈpeɪpər kʌmz aʊt ˈvɛri fɑːst/
sentences.text_native: Du papier blanc sort très rapidement.

sentences.text_target: He walks to the machine and takes the pages.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː wɔːks tuː ðə məˈʃiːn ənd teɪks ðə ˈpeɪdʒɪz/
sentences.text_native: Il s'approche de la machine et prend les pages.

sentences.text_target: Later, an update notification pops up.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈleɪtər, ən ˈʌpdeɪt ˌnəʊtɪfɪˈkeɪʃən pɒps ʌp/
sentences.text_native: Plus tard, une notification de mise à jour s'affiche.

sentences.text_target: He reads the text carefully on the screen.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː riːdz ðə tɛkst ˈkɛəfʊli ɒn ðə skriːn/
sentences.text_native: Il lit attentivement le texte sur l'écran.

sentences.text_target: He uses his mouse to close the window.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈjuːzɪz hɪz maʊs tuː kləʊz ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/
sentences.text_native: Il utilise sa souris pour fermer la fenêtre.

sentences.text_target: He finishes his daily computer work.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈfɪnɪʃɪz hɪz ˈdeɪli kəmˈpjuːtər wɜːk/
sentences.text_native: Il termine son travail informatique quotidien.

sentences.text_target: Then he shuts down the machine and leaves.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn hiː ʃʌts daʊn ðə məˈʃiːn ənd liːvz/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il éteint l'ordinateur et s'en va.
